items.title: Reuters: Ohio working-class voters 'rethinking' support for Trump; early vote favors Democrats
items.summary: Reuters original reporting (wire only, single-sourced) from Youngstown/Warren: interviews with blue-collar voters (a Trump 2016/2024 voter now undecided; a steel hauler: 'God knows we didn't vote for this') show rising prices, the Iran war and Trump's rhetoric chipping at his Ohio working-class support; Trumbull County data shows first-3-days early voting 1,224 Dems / 559 GOP / 453 unaffiliated; Hudson Institute's Sracic calls Brown 'a safe landing spot' for disaffected working-class voters. Tight Senate race (Husted vs Brown) and gov race (Ramaswamy vs Acton) at stake; Trump rallied Youngstown Oct 12. Wire-copy republishers only (devdiscourse, froggyweb) - not independent corroboration.
